name: decision
title: Decision / comparison
description: Comparison of options leading to a decision: recommendation first, the options against criteria, trade-offs, risks and the decision needed.
storyline: Recommendation first, then the evidence: the same criteria for every option, scored the same way. End with exactly what you need decided and by when.

slots.title: <We recommend X because Y>
slots.guidance: The recommendation, its main reason, cost and timing.

slots.title: <How the options compare on what matters>
slots.guidance: Options as columns, 3-6 criteria as rows, with values not adjectives.

slots.title: <The criterion that decides it>
slots.guidance: The deciding criterion per option as sorted bars.

slots.title: <What we gain and what we give up>
slots.guidance: Left: gains of the recommendation; right: costs and what we forgo.

slots.title: <What could go wrong and how we would know>
slots.guidance: Top risks with an early signal and a mitigation each.

slots.title: <The decision we need today>
slots.guidance: The exact decision, by whom, by when, and what happens next.

slots.title: Next steps: who does what by when
slots.guidance: Columns Action | Owner | Due. One row per commitment; a named owner and a date on every row.
